about:
# Frame Gambit

Shows each part of your UI only when you need it, with rules you set per frame.

## Install

Put the `FrameGambit` folder in `World of Warcraft/_forever_/Interface/AddOns/`, then `/reload`.

## Use

- Open the editor with `/fg`.
- Pick a frame on screen, or add one from the list.
- Add rules: combat, mouseover, target, group, events, chat and more.
- Rules are checked top to bottom. The first match sets the opacity.
- **Otherwise** applies when no rule matches.
- Drag rules to change their order.
- Rules can also set a size and a position (experimental).
- **Cinematic** is a second profile for questing with a minimal UI.
- Profiles can be exported and imported.

| Command or key | Does |
| --- | --- |
| `/fg` | Open the editor |
| `/fg pick` | Pick a frame on screen |
| `/fg cinematic` | Toggle Cinematic |
| `/fg status` | Run a check |
| Editor > Settings | Keys, minimap icon |
| Options > AddOns > Frame Gambit | Open, keys, minimap icon |

## Data

Settings: `WTF/Account/<account>/SavedVariables/FrameGambit.lua`.

## More

- [Guide](https://github.com/Mimezu/forever-FrameGambit/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md): conditions, gamepad, size and position, skins
- [Integration](https://github.com/Mimezu/forever-FrameGambit/blob/main/INTEGRATION.md): for addon authors
- [Changelog](https://github.com/Mimezu/forever-FrameGambit/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

releases.name: Frame Gambit 1.3.4
releases.notes:
**Download `FrameGambit-1.3.4.zip` below** (not "Source code").

1. Close the game.
2. Unzip into `World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\`.
3. Start the game and type `/fg`.

Settings are kept when you replace the folder.

## Changed

- Clean screenshot: minimap icons hidden too
- Clean screenshot: frames outside the interface, or ignoring its opacity, hidden too

releases.name: Frame Gambit 1.2.4
releases.notes:
**Download `FrameGambit-1.2.4.zip` below** (not "Source code").

1. Close the game.
2. Unzip it into `World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\`. You get the `FrameGambit` folder, ready to use.
3. Start the game and type `/fg`.

To update later, download the newest release zip and replace the folder. Your settings live in your own WTF folder and are kept.

New in 1.2.4: a **Screenshot without interface** key (Key Bindings > Frame Gambit) hides the whole interface and nameplates, takes the screenshot, and brings everything back once it is saved. See CHANGELOG.md.
